run_description: Runs a JGates plan in the workspace (today, quality-gate through the bridge) and writes the result outside the project.
run_option_cwd: Workspace folder to validate (default: the current folder).
run_option_bridge_mode: Only in projects without jgates.yml: quality-gate mode, full (default), quick or offline. quick and offline switch the external tools off in this run.
run_option_enable_pii: Only in projects without jgates.yml: turns on personal data (PII) detection. With jgates.yml, use the profile or --only.
run_option_enable_secrets: Only in projects without jgates.yml: turns on the secrets search (Gitleaks). With jgates.yml, use the profile or --only.
run_option_disable_iac: Only in projects without jgates.yml: switches the infrastructure-as-code analysis off in this run. With jgates.yml, use --skip.
run_option_run_project_tests: Only in projects without jgates.yml: runs the project tests. With jgates.yml, use the profile or --only capability:unit.
run_option_enable_coverage: Only in projects without jgates.yml: reads the coverage reports. With jgates.yml, use the profile or --only capability:coverage.
run_option_no_interactive: Never waits for input (the run already asks nothing).
run_bad_cwd: The workspace folder does not exist or is not a folder: {path}
run_summary_passed_reduced: approved with {count} checks switched off in this run
run_summary_failed_incomplete: rejected: {count} blocking violations; {missing} required requirements without evidence
run_text_workspace_changes: The validation left {count} files in the workspace.
run_option_profile: Profile of the plan built on the spot (default: the project's default profile).
run_option_path: Path of the paths scope (repeat for several).
run_option_base: Base reference of the changed scope.
run_option_head: Commit to analyze (Git reference), in a snapshot in the data folder: HEAD, the index and the working tree do not change. Works with any scope.
run_option_skip: Selector to switch off in this run only (repeat or comma-separate); the result comes out reduced if the profile required it.
run_option_only: Selector to keep; the rest is switched off in this run only (repeat for several).
run_option_template: Turns on a manual template in this run only (repeat for several).
run_option_plan: Runs the plan saved by jgates plan --out; refused if it was changed or if the configuration changed.
run_legacy_option_with_plan: The option {name} only applies in projects without jgates.yml; with configuration the run executes a plan.
run_legacy_option_with_plan_fix: Choose the set by profile, by --skip and --only (or jgates profiles create), and check with jgates plan.
run_plan_with_flags: The option {name} does not go with --plan: the given plan already carries profile, scope and selection.
run_plan_with_flags_fix: Generate another plan with jgates plan and the desired options, or remove --plan.
run_plan_unreadable: Could not read the plan at {path}: {detail}
run_plan_unreadable_fix: Check the --plan path and that the file is the JSON saved by jgates plan --out.
run_plan_not_approvable_fix: See the blockers with jgates plan, adjust the configuration or the selection and generate the plan again.
run_option_fail_fast: Stops at the first problem (a required stage that did not finish well or a blocking violation); the rest is recorded as not run because of --fail-fast.
run_option_events_jsonl: Also writes a copy of the run events (JSON Lines with runId, sequence and type) to this file; the run folder always has events.jsonl.
run_bad_events_path: The folder of the events file does not exist: {path}
run_bad_events_path_fix: Pass in --events-jsonl a file in a folder that already exists.
run_cancel_requested: Cancellation requested: ending the processes of the stage in progress and writing the partial result.
run_plan_from_options: Project without jgates.yml: plan built from the run options (bridge mode {mode}), equivalent to the run driven by options only.
run_summary_stale: ; analyzed files changed during the run: result out of date
run_summary_dirty: ; tree with local changes: does not approve the clean commit
run_snapshot_failed: Could not build the snapshot of commit {commit}: {detail}
run_snapshot_failed_fix: Check that the commit exists in the workspace repository and that git is on the PATH (or in JGATES_GIT).
run_option_semantic: Asks for the semantic AI review of this run. It only runs with a provider configured in jgates.yml (extensions.semantic-gate); the conclusion stays apart from the decision and never approves or rejects the core.
run_option_no_cache: Does not reuse results from earlier runs: all stages run again (same as JGATES_NO_CACHE=1).
run_option_waiver: Waives findings in this run only, besides .jgates/waivers.json: key=value pairs separated by semicolons (rule, fingerprint, path, expires, reason). Can be repeated.
run_install_hint: Some checks did not run because a tool is missing. Run: jgates doctor --fix
run_option_ci: Same as --no-interactive: never asks, not even to install a missing tool.
